solutions.title: Trim and split
solutions.strategy: Remove trailing spaces, split the remaining string by spaces, and read the length of the final token.

timeComplexity.explanation: Trimming and splitting scan the input string and allocate tokens whose total length is bounded by n.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The token array and trimmed string can store characters proportional to the input length.

solutions.title: Reverse scan
solutions.strategy: Walk backward past trailing spaces, then count characters until the previous space or the beginning of the string.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst case the scan moves across every character once from right to left.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the index and count variables are stored.
